name: Mycotyrant
description: Fungal hivemind that attacked the Oltec.

description_citations.text: "Reopening of Ixalan's Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Mycotyrant's fungus devours Downtown and Sunray Bay.
timeline.quote: the Mycotyrant 's fungus spreads silently, devouring entire settlements like Downtown and Sunray Bay

citation.work: Ixalan (continent)
citation.text: "Ixalan (continent)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xavier announces that they are the Mycotyrant, and the giant fungal creature is revealed.
timeline.quote: We are the Mycotyrant.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Xavier says Malcolm's companions and Downtown's residents have been incorporated into the colony.
timeline.quote: They have been incorporated into our colony, as have the ones who once resided in the place you call Downtown.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: When Malcolm asks what it wants, the Mycotyrant laughs with spores and answers 'Everything.'
timeline.quote: The Mycotyrant emitted a cloud of spores like a silent laugh.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The Mycotyrant explains that its colony found the miners and wanted to know more of them.
timeline.quote: You dug through stone and ore and veins of shining crystal until one of your kind found us.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Xavier says the Mycotyrant does not kill but changes and spreads.
timeline.quote: We do not kill. We change. We spread.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The Mycotyrant reveals it wants the sun above and Malcolm realizes it could consume Sunray Bay and Ixalan.
timeline.quote: You have another sun above, and we will have it.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The Mycotyrant announces it will assimilate Malcolm and Breeches and ascend to the surface.
timeline.quote: We will assimilate you, and we will ascend to the surface and its sun.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Malcolm sings to stun the colony and leads Breeches toward a water tunnel.
timeline.quote: Taking a deep breath, Malcolm began to sing.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The Mycotyrant breaks free of the song with a scream and the colony chases them.
timeline.quote: A hideous, many-mouthed scream echoed behind them.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The Mycotyrant's forces, including infected Downtown residents, dinosaurs and bats, erupt after them.
timeline.quote: The Mycotyrant's forces erupted from the tunnel.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Merfolk defend their city against the fungal invasion with elementals.
timeline.quote: Merfolk drew weapons, activated the enchantments in their armor, pulled out jade totems and summoned huge elemental creatures to repel the fungal invasion.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Wayta sees a siren fleeing from the door and a flood of fungal creatures behind him.
timeline.quote: A rush of greenish blackness poured through the portal behind him.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Akal says Anim is mobilizing the Thousand Moons, but forces will be stretched thin by two threats.
timeline.quote: My sister was mobilizing the Thousand Moons to mount a defense, but between this and Aclazotz, our forces will be spread thin.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The mycoids bridge the fissure with their own bodies.
timeline.quote: soon a thick bridge spanned the crevice.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Breeches fires a molten fireball that fells a titan and sends the colony into disarray.
timeline.quote: Every fungal creature around it shrieked in unison, some collapsing like puppets whose strings had been cut.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Sunray Bay is found deserted and marked by spores.
timeline.quote: Sunray Bay was as deserted as Downtown, with the same signs of the Mycotyrant's handiwork

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The Mycotyrant's surviving colony infects vampires camped in a jungle temple.
timeline.quote: One of them struck a swollen fungal sac with its blade, releasing a cloud of spores that settled on its skin like flies.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The colony's hosts reach High and Dry aboard a ship, hiding behind dark lenses.
timeline.quote: A new body stood on the deck of a ship—such useful things, ships—and watched as it approached High and Dry.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Oltec sealed the Core off from the world under siege from the Mycotyrant, until Huatli's party arrived.
timeline.quote: Centuries ago, under siege from the Mycotyrant, the Oltec sealed the Core off from the world... until Huatli's party arrived.

citation.work: The Core
citation.text: The Core (The Lost Caverns of Ixalan, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: In the mines, the party is attacked by mycoid-animated corpses and meets the Mycotyrant.
timeline.quote: before coming face to face with the entity that controlled them, the Mycotyrant

citation.work: Breeches
citation.text: "Breeches", section "Lost Caverns of Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Breeches destroys the Mycotyrant with a powerful firearm, collapsing the mycoids.
timeline.quote: Breeches destroyed the Mycotyrant with a powerful firearm

citation.work: Breeches
citation.text: "Breeches", section "Lost Caverns of Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A fungal outbreak at Topizielo spreads through the caverns, giving rise to the mycoids, and the Core is sealed.
timeline.quote: Those who remained in the caverns sealed all entrances to the Core to protect it from the spread of the mycoids.

citation.work: Core of Paradise
citation.text: "Core of Paradise", section "Birth of the Mycotyrant". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk frees Aclazotz, who tries to snuff out the inner sun, while the Mycotyrant attacks the Oltec; both are defeated but escape to the surface.
timeline.quote: The latter faction freed Aclazotz , who then attempted to snuff out the plane's inner sun.

citation.work: Core of Paradise
citation.text: "Core of Paradise", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Breeches investigate Downtown and escape the Mycotyrant; Breeches destroys it with a bomb.
timeline.quote: Breeches destroyed the Mycotyrant with a powerful bomb

citation.work: Malcolm Lee
citation.text: "Malcolm Lee", section "Lost Caverns of Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An outbreak of fungal disease strikes one of the Komon's grandest cities, the beginning of the mycoids.
timeline.quote: This fungus was the beginning of the mycoids

citation.work: Mycotyrant
citation.text: "Mycotyrant", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Malcolm Lee and Breeches investigate Downtown's destruction and meet the Mycotyrant, who tries to assimilate them; Malcolm's hypnotic song lets them escape.
timeline.quote: Malcolm used his hypnotic song to get away.

citation.work: Mycotyrant
citation.text: "Mycotyrant", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Oltec fight off the Mycotyrant with spirits in the Core while Breeches explodes its nexus, killing subordinate mycoids.
timeline.quote: Breeches managed to explode its nexus with a powerful firearm

citation.work: Mycotyrant
citation.text: "Mycotyrant", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Mycotyrant survives, takes over Sunray Bay and sails for High and Dry in a new body.
timeline.quote: taking over the town of Sunray Bay to replenish its followers

citation.work: Mycotyrant
citation.text: "Mycotyrant", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brazen Coalition pirates track the Mycotyrant into the Core.
timeline.quote: tracked the Mycotyrant to the Core

citation.work: Reopening of Ixalan's Core
citation.text: "Reopening of Ixalan's Core", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz transforms followers into batlike demons to extinguish Chimil while the Mycotyrant assaults the Oltec.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz transformed his followers into batlike demons

citation.work: Reopening of Ixalan's Core
citation.text: "Reopening of Ixalan's Core", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Huatli kills Vito and Breeches destroys the Mycotyrant's nexus body; both god and hive mind escape.
timeline.quote: Huatli killed Vito

citation.work: Reopening of Ixalan's Core
citation.text: "Reopening of Ixalan's Core", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Amalia leave for Ravnica; Quint finds a preserved Coin Empire vessel; the Mycotyrant overruns Sunray Bay; Aclazotz seeks an alliance with Vona de Iedo.
timeline.quote: the Mycotyrant overran the coastal town of Sunray Bay

citation.work: Reopening of Ixalan's Core
citation.text: "Reopening of Ixalan's Core", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
